paragraphs: Rec builds software for parks and recreation agencies, alongside a public side where residents look up what their city offers. On the resident side the site invites people to explore activities, parks and programs in cities that use Rec.

The company describes its aim as building technology to power the future of recreation. It positions the product as what modern parks and recreation departments run on. Programs and registration is the piece of the offering named on the home page.

The site says the product is now available across the US. It also points visitors toward a few partner agencies. Apex Park and Recreation District is one of the names shown there. The footer gives the corporate name as Rec Technologies, Inc.

quote.text: Modern parks & rec departments run on Rec Technologies.
